title: SlcNotificationInboundV1
description: Inbound SLC notification received from the SLC Data Exchange service and submitted via POST /api/v1/regulatory/slc/notifications. Covers loan entitlements, payment confirmations, status changes, and overpayment notices received from SLC.

enrolmentId.description: SRS enrolment UUID. Must match an existing enrolment for the tenant.

notificationTypeCode.description: SLC notification type. Values: 'entitlement' (loan entitlement issued), 'payment' (payment confirmed), 'status-change' (enrolment status change notification), 'overpayment' (overpayment notice).

effectiveDate.description: Effective date of the notification event (YYYY-MM-DD).

amount.description: Monetary amount associated with the notification, as a decimal string or number. Currency is always GBP. Null if not applicable (e.g. status-change notifications).

rawPayload.description: Raw SLC message payload for audit purposes. Stored as-is; not validated.

idempotencyKey.description: SLC-provided transaction reference for idempotency. If present, duplicate submissions with the same key are rejected.

notificationId.description: Client-supplied notification UUID. If provided, used as the stored record ID for idempotency.
